statement: Exact ordinary matrix-kernel annihilator and submodule algorithms over every finitely presented integer algebra and its finite localizations
depends_on: GLNY2020 Theorems4.6 and6.5; Noetherian integer polynomial modules; explicit basis and quotient syzygy transfer
notes: Established integer Groebner algorithms used with exact hypotheses; arbitrary zero divisors and torsion allowed

statement: Every henselization of a finitely presented integer algebra at a supplied finite odd-residue point has exact finite-name arithmetic and complete ordinary canonical split WG classification and operations
notes: Singular and nonreduced mixed-characteristic bases included; ordinary termination without factorization branch or approximation oracle; finite rings use a decidable set of names
